method.fixtures: node scripts/preview-with-fixtures.mjs; deterministic 50-record normalized market envelope plus detail, chart, and sentiment fixtures
method.mobile: five Lighthouse runs with the standard simulated-mobile profile
method.desktop: five Lighthouse runs with the Lighthouse desktop preset
method.webVitals: twenty mobile Chromium flows with 150 ms latency, 1.6 Mbps down, 750 Kbps up, and 4x CPU slowdown
method.quality: npm test; npm audit --audit-level=high; npm run bundle:check

limitations: This is a local controlled lab run with deterministic API fixtures, not field data or user traffic.
Cloudflare cache-hit rate, production p50/p95 latency, third-party requests avoided, and production error rate remain unmeasured until account authorization and deployment are complete.
The local Web Vitals harness exercises application interactions; it does not represent real-user monitoring.
